required.quote: submit evidence of one year of accounting experience in a form prescribed by the division

experience_source.quote: submit evidence of accounting experience in a form the division approves by rule of at least: (i) one year of accounting experience for an individual with a master's degree or the equivalent with a concentration of accounting and business; or (ii) two years of accounting experience for an individual with a bachelor's degree or the equivalent with a concentration of accounting and business

duration.value: 1 year (master's) or 2 years (bachelor's); prior to 7/1/2026: 1 year
duration.quote: one year of accounting experience for an individual with a master's degree or the equivalent with a concentration of accounting and business; or (ii) two years of accounting experience for an individual with a bachelor's degree or the equivalent with a concentration of accounting and business

kind.value: accounting experience under supervision of a licensed CPA
kind.quote: "Accounting experience" means applying accounting and auditing skills and principles that are taught as a part of the professional education qualifying a person for licensure under this chapter and generally accepted by the profession, under the supervision of a licensed certified public accountant.

exams.name: AICPA Uniform CPA Examination
exams.notes: Applicant must sit for and meet conditioning requirements as established by the AICPA. Prior to 7/1/2026, must complete at least 120 semester hours before sitting; after 7/1/2026, must have at least a bachelor's degree.

interval_years.quote: The division shall issue each license and registration under this chapter in accordance with a two-year renewal cycle established by rule.

required.quote: as a condition precedent for a license renewal, each licensee shall, during each two-year licensure cycle or other cycle defined by rule, complete 80 hours of qualified continuing professional education in accordance with standards defined by rule.

hours_per_period.quote: complete 80 hours of qualified continuing professional education in accordance with standards defined by rule.

period_years.quote: during each two-year licensure cycle or other cycle defined by rule

At least 3 hours of ethics education covering AICPA Code of Professional Conduct, case-based instruction, ethical dilemmas faced by accounting professionals, or business ethics (for out-of-state principal place of business licensees)
topical_requirements.quote: completing at least one hour of continuing professional education that covers: (i) this chapter; and (ii) Utah Administrative Code, R156-26a, Utah Certified Public Accountant Licensing Act Rule; and (e) completing at least three hours of ethics education

available.quote: The division may issue a license under this chapter to a person who holds a license as a certified public accountant issued by any other state of the United States of America if the applicant for licensure by endorsement

requirements.value: Licensure by endorsement available for out-of-state CPA licensees. Applicant must show evidence of passing qualifying examinations and either meet Utah requirements applicable at time of original licensure, have 4 years of professional experience after passing the AICPA Uniform CPA Examination within the 10 years preceding application, or demonstrate substantial equivalency of education, examination, and experience to Utah requirements.
requirements.quote: shows evidence of having passed the qualifying examinations; and ... meets the requirements for licensure which were applicable in this state at the time of the issuance of the applicant's license ... or had four years of professional experience after passing the AICPA Uniform CPA Examination ... or shows evidence that the applicant's education, examination record, and experience are substantially equivalent to the requirements

exists.quote: There is created the Utah Board of Accountancy consisting of four licensed certified public accountants and one member of the general public.

credential_type.quote: The division shall issue to an individual who qualifies under this chapter a license in the classification of Certified Public Accountant.

is_mandatory.quote: A license is required for an individual to engage in the practice of public accounting, except as specifically provided in Section 58-26a-305 or 58-1-307.

title_protection.quote: using "certified public accountant," "public accountant," "CPA," or any other title, designation, words, letters, abbreviation, sign, card, or device tending to indicate that the person is a certified public accountant, unless that person: (a) has a current license as a certified public accountant issued under this chapter

scope_protection.quote: except as provided in Section 58-26a-305, engaging in the following conduct if not licensed under this chapter to practice public accountancy: (a) issuing a report on financial statements of any other person, firm, organization, or governmental unit

disciplinary_grounds.description: Engaging in unprofessional conduct as defined by statute or rule
disciplinary_grounds.quote: the applicant or licensee has engaged in unprofessional conduct, as defined by statute or rule under this title
disciplinary_grounds.citation: UMBRELLA / Chapter 1 - Division of Professional Licensing Act

disciplinary_grounds.description: Engaging in unlawful conduct as defined by statute
disciplinary_grounds.quote: the applicant or licensee has engaged in unlawful conduct as defined by statute under this title
disciplinary_grounds.citation: UMBRELLA / Chapter 1 - Division of Professional Licensing Act

disciplinary_grounds.description: Determined to be mentally incompetent by a court of competent jurisdiction
disciplinary_grounds.quote: the applicant or licensee has been determined to be mentally incompetent by a court of competent jurisdiction
disciplinary_grounds.citation: UMBRELLA / Chapter 1 - Division of Professional Licensing Act

disciplinary_grounds.description: Unable to practice with reasonable skill and safety due to illness, substance use, or mental/physical condition
disciplinary_grounds.quote: the applicant or licensee is unable to practice the occupation or profession with reasonable skill and safety because of illness, drunkenness, excessive use of drugs, narcotics, chemicals, or other type of material, or as a result of a mental or physical condition
disciplinary_grounds.citation: UMBRELLA / Chapter 1 - Division of Professional Licensing Act

disciplinary_grounds.description: Undertaking an engagement knowing the licensee could not reasonably complete it with professional competence
disciplinary_grounds.quote: undertaking an engagement when the licensee knows or should know that the licensee could not reasonably expect to complete it with professional competence

disciplinary_grounds.description: Making unauthorized disclosures of confidential information obtained in practice
disciplinary_grounds.quote: making unauthorized disclosures of confidential information obtained in the practice of public accountancy

disciplinary_grounds.description: Engaging in business activity creating an undisclosed conflict of interest with the licensee's practice
disciplinary_grounds.quote: engaging in any business or activity that creates a conflict of interest with a licensee's practice in the profession when the licensee knows or should know that it is a conflict of interest and the licensee does not fully disclose the conflict of interest in writing to all affected parties

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing to meet continuing professional education or peer review requirements
disciplinary_grounds.quote: failing to meet the requirements for continuing professional education or peer review required under this chapter

disciplinary_grounds.description: Issuing a report or performing attest engagement when not independent in fact and appearance
disciplinary_grounds.quote: issuing a report on financial statements of a client, other than a report in which a lack of independence is disclosed, or performing an attest engagement subject to the attestation standards of the American Institute of Certified Public Accountants when the licensee is not independent, in fact and appearance, to the client.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Receiving a commission when also performing audit, review, compilation, or examination of prospective financial information for the same client
disciplinary_grounds.quote: A licensee may not, for a commission, recommend or refer to a client a product or service, or for a commission recommend or refer a product or service to be supplied by a client, or receive a commission, when the licensee also performs for that client: (i) an audit or review of a financial statement; (ii) a compilation of a financial statement ... or (iii) an examination of prospective financial information.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Performing services for a contingent fee when also performing attest/compilation services, or preparing tax returns for contingent fee
disciplinary_grounds.quote: A licensee may not: (i) perform for a contingent fee a professional service for, or receive a contingent fee from a client for whom the licensee or the licensee's firm performs: (A) an audit or review of a financial statement; (B) a compilation ... or (C) an examination of prospective financial information; or (ii) prepare an original or amended tax return or claim for a tax refund for a contingent fee for a client.

definition_quote.value: "Practice of public accounting" means, while holding oneself out as a certified public accountant, offering to perform or performing one or more kinds of services involving the use of auditing or accounting skills, including issuing reports or opinions on financial statements, performing attestation engagements, performing one or more kinds of advisory or consulting services, preparing tax returns, or furnishing advice on tax matters for a client.
definition_quote.quote: "Practice of public accounting" means, while holding oneself out as a certified public accountant, offering to perform or performing one or more kinds of services involving the use of auditing or accounting skills, including issuing reports or opinions on financial statements, performing attestation engagements, performing one or more kinds of advisory or consulting services, preparing tax returns, or furnishing advice on tax matters for a client.

value: issuing reports or opinions on financial statements
methods_authorized.quote: offering to perform or performing one or more kinds of services involving the use of auditing or accounting skills, including issuing reports or opinions on financial statements, performing attestation engagements, performing one or more kinds of advisory or consulting services, preparing tax returns, or furnishing advice on tax matters for a client.

value: audit or other engagement in accordance with Statements on Auditing Standards (SAS)

attest_services_types.quote: "Attest and attestation engagement" means providing any or all of the following financial statement services: (i) an audit or other engagement to be performed in accordance with the Statements on Auditing Standards (SAS); (ii) a review of a financial statement to be performed in accordance with the Statements on Standards for Accounting and Review Services (SSARS); (iii) an examination of prospective financial information to be performed in accordance with the Statements on Standards for Attestation Engagements (SSAE); (iv) an examination, review, or agreed upon procedures engagement to be performed in accordance with the Statements on Standards for Attestation Engagements (SSAE), other than an examination described in Subsection (3)(a)(iii); or (v) an engagement to be performed in accordance with the standards of the PCAOB.

compilation_services_authorized.quote: "Compilation" means providing a service to be performed in accordance with Statements on Standards for Accounting and Review Services (SSARS) that is presenting, in the form of financial statements, information that is the representation of management or owners, without undertaking to express any assurance on the statements.

education_semester_hours_required.quote: successful completion of a total of 150 semester hours or 225 quarter hours of collegiate level education with a concentration in accounting, auditing, and business

exam_sit_hours_minimum.quote: demonstrate completion of at least 120 semester hours or 180 quarter hours of the education requirement described in Subsection 58-26a-302(1)(c)

ethics_exam_required.quote: the AICPA Examination of Professional Ethics for CPAs

practice_privilege_no_notice_required.quote: Notwithstanding any other provision of law, a person who qualifies under Subsection (1)(a) has all the privileges of a licensee of this state and may engage in acts included within the definition of the practice of public accountancy, whether in person or by mail, telephone, or electronic means, based on a practice privilege in this state, and no notice, fee, or other submission shall be provided by that person.

value: Consent to personal and subject matter jurisdiction and disciplinary authority of the division
Comply with this chapter and the rules made under this chapter
Cease offering or rendering professional services in this state if license from principal place of business becomes invalid

practice_privilege_consent_conditions.quote: the person consents, as a condition of the grant of this privilege: (A) to personal and subject matter jurisdiction and disciplinary authority of the division; (B) to comply with this chapter and the rules made under this chapter; (C) that in the event the license from the state of the person's principal place of business becomes invalid, the person shall cease offering or rendering professional services in this state both individually and on behalf of the firm; and (D) to the appointment of the state board which issued the person's license as the person's agent upon whom process may be served in an action or proceeding brought by the division against the licensee

firm_majority_cpa_ownership_required.quote: have, notwithstanding any other provision of law, a simple majority of the ownership of the Certified Public Accountant firm, in terms of financial interests and voting rights of all partners, officers, shareholders, members, or managers, held by individuals who are certified public accountants

nonlicensee_firm_owners_permitted.quote: A Certified Public Accountant firm may include owners who are not licensed under this chapter as outlined in Subsection (3)(a)(iii), provided that: (i) the firm designates a licensee of this state who is responsible for the proper registration of the Certified Public Accountant firm and identifies that individual to the division; and (ii) all nonlicensed owners are active individual participants in the CPA firm.

peer_review_required_for_firm_renewal.quote: At the time of renewal a licensee shall show satisfactory evidence of each of the following renewal requirements: ... (b) successful completion of a peer review meeting the requirements established by rule by the division in collaboration with the board.

inactive_license_status_available.quote: In accordance with Title 63G, Chapter 3, Utah Administrative Rulemaking Act, the division may adopt rules permitting inactive licensure.
inactive_license_status_available.citation: UMBRELLA / Chapter 1 - Division of Professional Licensing Act

working_papers_ownership_by_licensee.quote: All statements, records, schedules, working papers, and memoranda made by a licensee under this chapter, incident to or in the course of professional service to a client, are the property of the licensee, in the absence of any express agreement between the licensee and the client to the contrary.

commission_prohibition_during_attest.quote: A licensee may not, for a commission, recommend or refer to a client a product or service, or for a commission recommend or refer a product or service to be supplied by a client, or receive a commission, when the licensee also performs for that client: (i) an audit or review of a financial statement; (ii) a compilation of a financial statement when the licensee expects, or reasonably might expect, that a third party will use the financial statement and the licensee's compilation report does not disclose a lack of independence; or (iii) an examination of prospective financial information.

contingent_fee_prohibition_during_attest.quote: A licensee may not: (i) perform for a contingent fee a professional service for, or receive a contingent fee from a client for whom the licensee or the licensee's firm performs: (A) an audit or review of a financial statement; (B) a compilation of a financial statement when the licensee expects, or reasonably might expect, that a third party will use the financial statement and the licensee's compilation report does not disclose a lack of independence; or (C) an examination of prospective financial information; or (ii) prepare an original or amended tax return or claim for a tax refund for a contingent fee for a client.

safe_harbor_disclaimer_language_for_nonl.quote: "Report" does not include a financial statement prepared by an unlicensed person if: (i) that financial statement has a cover page which includes essentially the following language: "I (we) have prepared the accompanying financial statements of (name of entity) as of (time period) for the (period) then ended. This presentation is limited to preparing, in the form of financial statements, information that is the representation of management (owners). I (we) have not audited or reviewed the accompanying financial statements and accordingly do not express an opinion or any other form of assurance on them."

cpa_emeritus_or_retired_status_available.quote: A person currently licensed as a certified public accountant may, on any renewal date of that license, apply for and obtain a transfer of that license to a status of CPA emeritus registration

ethics_cpe_hours_required.quote: completing at least three hours of ethics education that cover one or more of the following areas: (i) the AICPA Code of Professional Conduct; (ii) case-based instruction focusing on real-life situational learning; (iii) ethical dilemmas faced by accounting professionals; or (iv) business ethics.

liability_privity_limitation.quote: A licensee, a CPA firm registered under this chapter, and any employee, partner, member, officer, or shareholder of a licensee or CPA firm are not liable to persons with whom they are not in privity of contract for civil damages resulting from acts, omissions, decisions, or other conduct in connection with professional services performed by that person, except for: (1) acts, omissions, decisions, or conduct that constitute fraud or intentional misrepresentations; or (2) other acts, omissions, decisions, or conduct, if the person performing the professional services: (a) knew that a primary intent of the client was for the professional services to benefit or influence the particular person seeking to establish liability; and (b) identified in writing to the client that the professional services performed on behalf of the client were intended to be relied upon by the particular person seeking to establish liability.

independence_requirement_for_attest.quote: issuing a report on financial statements of a client, other than a report in which a lack of independence is disclosed, or performing an attest engagement subject to the attestation standards of the American Institute of Certified Public Accountants when the licensee is not independent, in fact and appearance, to the client.
